newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KLASCO MAINTAINS SLIDE, FEW GAINERS SEEN.
newsitem.headline: KLASCO MAINTAINS SLIDE, FEW GAINERS SEEN.

text.p: Lithuanian shares remained mixed in early Wednesday trade while Klaipeda Stevedoring continued to dip with few gainers on the scene, dealers said.
"Klaipeda Stevedoring continued to go down by the maximum 10 percent for a second session in a row," said Grazhina Bachiuliene, dealer with Vilfima.
The state-run company saw its shares dip to 13.77 from 15.8 litas on Wednesday. The company was quoted at around 17 litas earlier in April.

"The fall was was caused by the decision of the company's shareholders meeting to double the share capital of the company from reserves which will lead to an increased number of shares on the market," Bachiuliene added.
Lithuanian Gas, which reported losses of 16 million litas, regained some ground to advance to 1.9 litas from 1.82 litas.
"Demand for Lithuanian Gas was pretty high since the price was rather low and few investors wanted to sell their stake at that price," Bachiuliene said.
"Another company in high demand was Birzai Dairy which rose slightly to 10.25 litas from 10.02 litas," Bachiuliene added.
Among banks, Vilnius Bank was only one to go up slightly to 223 litas, an increase of 0.9 percent, while Hermis and Snoras remained unchanged at 175 litas and 28 litas respectively.
